sentences.text: Operating cash flow was 180.29% of reported profit in FY26.
Debt stood at 0.41x equity and interest was covered 8.85x over the trailing twelve months.
Profit rose 24.36% in FY26, and quarterly net profit was up against the same quarter a year before.
Return on equity was 6.93% and return on capital employed 7.29%.
Profit compounded at 6.54% a year over 5Y while sales compounded at 14.61%.
The share closed 25.64% below its 52-week closing high and fell 13.75% over 1 year.
Sales fell 1.63% in FY26 while profit rose 24.36%, and the sheet does not show how much of that came from other income.
The P/E of 41.36x sits inside its year-end range of FY22 to FY26, which says nothing on its own about earnings ahead.
Futures open interest rose 6.12% on a down day, and one session cannot show whether those positions stay open.
